tests.purpose: Capture the selected Dev version, reject credential-like configuration, and hash the exact package.
Open a reviewable PR and run offline package checks on the captured configuration.
Require manual default-branch dispatch, explicit deployment confirmation and an exact reviewed commit match before Azure login or any Prod resource write.
Create a new version on the existing Prod agent, read it back, and pin the stable endpoint.
Treat optional runtime verification, especially MCP execution, as independent from successful configuration deployment.
